interpretation: The deployed score formula reconstructs exactly on all 62 stored Shadow rows.
The 100-point clamp does not currently compress this bounded archive: maximum pre-clamp score is 90.63.
Actor divergence is common, so aggregate institutional total frequently hides economically different actor directions.

Same-session direction information forms a larger share of pre-clamp score than persistence beyond day 1 in this bounded archive. This supports testing the nonlinear consensus bonus separately from true multi-session persistence rather than assuming all streak-related points are independent persistence information.
Large-holder concentration is also a material score component descriptively, but its weekly ownership cadence and missing immutable chipAsOfDate in research rows prevent daily-independent inference.
Structural correlation is descriptive on only two scan dates; it is not an alpha estimate or statistical significance claim.
